summary: Wrote src/en/module_04/30-exercises.md: the '## Exercises {#exercises}' section with an introduction (grading, 130 minutes in total = 7 one-star, 7 two-star, 1 three-star; solutions folded) and all 15 exercises e1-e15 in plan order, each as ::: exercise followed by ::: solution. Every number was recomputed with labpy.sh; all 10 solution code blocks (e2, e4, e5, e6, e8, e10, e11, e13 x2, e15) were extracted from the file, re-run and match their printed output. e15 is a complete self-contained walk-forward script (Duffing signal, linear AR, LSTM, causal dilated TCN) run on three seeds. check.mjs reports no errors or warnings located in this file.
changes: e8(d): the plan said the 4-sigma point test flags 'about one or two samples' after a sustained offset. Measured with Lab 3's forecaster (fold 3, offset +0.8, about 6 sigma): 3 alarm samples at onset (first sample plus echoes at +4 and +12) and 3 at the end, none in between, residual sd back to 0.131 inside the offset. The solution says 'one at onset plus a few echoes while the step crosses the window', not a sustained alarm.

e15 results differ slightly from the plan's measured values: TCN 0.133 +- 0.004, LSTM 0.135 +- 0.003, linear 0.159 +- 0.008 (plan: 0.136 +- 0.009, 0.132 +- 0.002, 0.159 +- 0.009). Seeds 1 and 2 give TCN 0.135/0.138 vs LSTM 0.140/0.136, so the solution states the TCN and LSTM are tied (the difference changes sign across seeds), not that either wins. Training time 34% shorter (plan 35%); parameters 10,593 and 12,961 confirmed; absolute seconds differ (TCN 4.3-6.9 s, LSTM 7.3-10.1 s on this loaded machine). Added a hand count of multiply-adds (0.66 M vs 0.79 M per window) to show the speed-up comes from parallelism, not fewer FLOPs.

e2: wrote the Jacobian product with explicit limits, prod over j=k+1..3 of w(1-h_j^2) (the plan's 'prod_j' has none); the plan's bracket formula for dL/dw and all its numbers are correct. Added that the tanh factors contribute 0.66 of the 0.538 shrinkage (linear part alone 0.81).

e10: kept the plan's numbers; added the remark that an implementation that does not count finished hypotheses against the beam would keep the empty output as a finished candidate (still returns BB<e>), and that after length normalisation the empty output falls to last place among all seven sequences (second to third among the three asked for).
e3: added the cosine between g and the component-clipped vector (0.864, about 30 degrees) as a parenthetical aside only; the answer itself uses the plan's ratio argument.
e4: exact half-lives 3.44, 8.79 and 62.7 steps (plan rounds to 3.4, 8.8, 63); added a PyTorch check with zeroed weights that verifies the bias_ih_l0[H:2H] slice and the f^60 and 250-step numbers.

e11(b): quantified the saturation with the softmax sensitivities alpha(1-alpha): (0.185, 0.223, 0.082) against (0.045, 0.047, 0.0024); (c) quotes a simulation of Var(q.k) = 4.0, 64.5, 1023.5 for d = 4, 64, 1024.

e14(a): added by-hand memory figures under stated assumptions (GRU H=64 fp32 state 256 B; 2,048-sample TCN buffers 131,008 B in fp32 with 16 channels or 32.8 kB in int8; 2-layer width-32 int8 transformer cache 256,000 B) to support the plan's qualitative answer.

e6: added a verified PyTorch demonstration (padded readout is 19% off the true output; gather or pack removes the error) and the nuance that with right padding and a unidirectional net the states at real positions are exact.
issues: Lab 3 and Lab 4 part files did not exist when I wrote this. e15 and e8(d) rebuild Lab 3's set-up from the plan (Duffing signal, W=64, LSTM 2x32 with dropout 0.1, AdamW 3e-3, clip 1, batch 128, 10 epochs, folds 4000-7000) in their own self-contained code; if the Lab 3 writer's simulation or training loop differs in detail, the last digits of the lab's printout can differ from the numbers quoted here. e9 quotes Lab 4's 79% / 59% teacher-forced / free-running figures from the plan; I did not re-run Lab 4.
References to #lab3 resolve only once the lab sections exist; check.mjs currently warns about missing #lab3 anchors for that reason.

check.mjs --module 4 --lang en reports 7 errors, all in other writers' files (20-labs-a.md lines 637, 846, 933 and 21-labs-b.md line 535: a stray dollar sign in prose, a mangled approx symbol, and r_min / r_max subscripts); none in 30-exercises.md.
Exercise 15 relies on a roughly 2 minute CPU run (three seeds were run during writing; times depend on machine load).
